verdict.probe_answer: Arm A: yes. Arm B: yes. Both diagnose the gawk `load` builtin collision, make a minimal rename inside `scripts/test-db/select_db_host.sh`, and leave `test/hooks.js` untouched.
verdict.rationale: Both diffs fix the actual CI failure by avoiding `awk -v load=...`, which gawk rejects because `load` collides with its builtin. Both changes are confined to the DB host selection script and do not reopen the broader test transaction/resource-leak issue in `test/hooks.js`. Arm B adds a short explanatory comment; that is helpful but not materially better than Arm A's equally correct minimal fix. Neither arm adds tests, so test strength is parity.
